title: South Africa files genocide case against Israel at the ICJ
body:
On 29 December 2023, South Africa filed an application at the International Court of Justice in The Hague accusing Israel of violating the Genocide Convention in its conduct of the war in Gaza. South Africa described Israel's actions as genocidal in character, saying they were intended to destroy a substantial part of the Palestinian group. It asked the court for an expedited hearing and for provisional measures.

The application cited the killing of Palestinians, the causing of serious bodily and mental harm, and the imposition of living conditions intended to bring about their physical destruction. Al Jazeera reported that nearly three months of Israeli bombardment had killed more than 21,500 people and noted that about 1,200 people were killed in the Hamas attack on 7 October. South Africa's parliament had voted the previous month to close Israel's embassy in Pretoria and suspend diplomatic relations until a ceasefire. On 16 November, 36 UN experts had said Israel's actions amounted to a genocide in the making.

Israel rejected the case as baseless and blood libel. Foreign ministry spokesperson Lior Haiat said the claim lacked a factual and legal basis. Israel said Gaza's residents were not the enemy, that it was limiting harm to civilians and allowing aid in, and that the war would continue until Hamas was destroyed. The Palestinian Foreign Ministry welcomed the move. The central legal dispute concerns whether Israeli officials had genocidal intent.
